Spent the week re-familiarizing myself with Wanabusful, reorganizing the repo so the root-level `index.html` becomes the landing page for every micro tool while leaving the heavier Next.js pieces inside `othertools/` untouched.

## Static tools, single page

Wanabusful now exposes one simple HTML hub that links directly to all of the mini apps so Netlify (and any quick deploy) can point to the top-level file while the static folders stay independent:

- **`csv-to-json/`** – Dynamo DB-style CSV → JSON converter for quick uploads.
- **`base64/`** – Fast Base64 encoder/decoder with clipboard helpers.
- **`json-formatter/`** – Pretty-print or minify tiny stubs before committing.
- **`lorem/`** – Lorem Ipsum generator tuned for placeholder paragraphs.
- **`url-encode/`** – Percent-encoding and decoding for API payloads.
- **`uuid/`** – UUID v4 generator with copy buttons.
- **`markdown-preview/`** – Live Markdown + marked.js preview for docs.
- **`timestamp/`** – Unix timestamp ↔ human date converter.
- **`color-converter/`** – Hex ↔ RGB converter with real-time swatches.
- **`slug-generator/`** – Title-to-slug helper enforcing lowercase hyphens.

The Next.js suite inside `othertools/` still hosts the camera, signature, and audio experiments, so the hub simply links to it when the heavier tools are needed.

## Notification alert

The alerts feed now includes a dedicated entry for this update (`/notifications/2026-02-08`), tagged with `wanabusful` and `tools`, so the landing page can surface the news inside the Alerts UI. That notification links back to this blog and the live hub so friends know where the refreshed experiences live.

## Why this blog?

If you visit Wanabusful anytime soon you’ll hear the same story: a small, static landing page points to the growing mini-tool collection, a notification lets you know about the refresh, and this post documents the whole stack for future reference. Enjoy the mini adventures on the hub!
